Market today: We're seeing conflicting signals on inflation, with one report showing it lighter than expected and another indicating a rise. This creates uncertainty, especially for your tech/chip heavy book. Meanwhile, consumer spending is up, which could be good for earnings but also fuels inflation worries.

Your holdings: SOXL (-34.14%) and SPAL (-34.27%) are both leveraged ETFs in "SELL" status with significant drawdowns. Given you're on margin, these amplified drops hurt extra and need immediate attention.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the Micron earnings report after the bell, as it could impact your MUU position and the broader chip sector. Also, monitor how the market digests the conflicting inflation data.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing your leveraged positions with deep drawdowns while staying alert to chip sector news and inflation clarity.
plays: Consider trimming or exiting SOXL given its "SELL" status and -34.14% loss; leveraged decay and margin amplify risk.
Review SPAL, also "SELL" and -34.27% down; its leveraged nature and margin exposure demand attention.
The scanner shows an "ACCUMULATE" setup for SMH (entry 606.68-606.06, stop 604.38). Consider adding if conviction aligns.
